questions.stem: Why does menstruation occur if pregnancy does not happen?

options.text: Because oestrogen levels rise too high
Because the corpus luteum breaks down, progesterone falls, and the uterus lining cannot be maintained
Because FSH stimulates the lining to break down
Because LH levels increase at the end of the cycle

questions.explanation: If no pregnancy occurs, the corpus luteum degenerates and stops producing progesterone. Without progesterone to maintain it, the thick uterus lining breaks down and is shed as menstruation.
